sources.snippet: Reference Model: Discourages "cheating" or extreme deviations, ensuring the policy remains reasonably aligned with its initial state. Advantages of GRPO: In large language models, it removes the need for a separate value network, reducing memory and compute costs while aligning well with "comparative" Reward Model designs.
